key_points: 4 ANOTHER PEEK BEYOND THE POINT 4.1 A Quick Recap of Decimals Recall that decimals are the natural extension of the Indian place value 1 1 1 system to represent decimal fractions ( , , , and so on) and 10 100 1000 their sums.
For example, 27.53 refers to a quantity that has: • 2 Tens • 7 Units (Ones) • 5 Tenths • 3 Hundredths We have already learned how to multiply and divide fractions.
In this chapter, we will learn how to perform these operations with decimals.
You will see that the procedures for multiplying and dividing decimals are natural extensions of the procedures for multiplying and dividing counting numbers.
Jonali says a fraction and Pallabi gives the equivalent decimal.
She purchases 50 g of Cinnamon, 100 g of Cumin seeds, 25 g of Cardamom and 250 g of Pepper.
Express each of the quantities in kilograms by writing them in terms of fractions as well as decimals.
